summary: Full retest of the CRMEvent dropdown-management, Taglia/Note and PersonMask work plus the fixes made since iteration_180. Backend: the new tests/test_iter181_option_lists_fixes.py passes 5/5, and the existing test_option_lists_taglia.py and test_anagrafica_staff_unify.py pass (10 passed, 7 skipped). All iteration_180 fixes are confirmed: tipologie_struttura add/usage/rename/409; platform scope shows defaults when no doc exists, adding keeps the other defaults, new orgs inherit them, non-superadmin gets 403; esigenze_alimentari usage and rename cover persons+staff arrays with arrayFilters (3 records); tipi_postazione usage counts only station shifts; public taglia rejected with 400 'Taglia non valida' for unknown or disabled values; /settings/usage matches /settings/lists. UI on desktop and 390px also passes: profile menu sections and links, sidebar/drawer without Utenti e Permessi and Impostazioni, table columns, mask via Aggiungi Staff/Volontario/row click/pencil (no Qualifica/LinkedIn/Foto; Taglia+Note saved and reloaded; age; CF -> Roma (RM)), the inline '+ Aggiungi' fields checked (Taglia, mansione, Strutture tipologia, Ospitalità esigenze, sponsor livello), trash last with name+surname confirm (Annulla keeps the person, confirm archives it), taglia filter, all Impostazioni list actions, Events tipologia showing only managed values, and /partecipa taglia with active values only and no Note. Event Planner and Control Room are locked for trial orgs, so I only code-reviewed their inline add.

minor.issue: An archived person (archiviato=true) is still returned by /api/staff and still shows in Ospitalità & Pasti (seen in the UI after deleting TEST_Rossi181). They are only hidden from /persons and persons-enriched. Still open from iteration_180.

Usage and rename only cover shifts.area with planner_station_id. Station tipologia saved in Event Planner project features (properties.tipologia) is not counted or renamed. A tipologia used only by stations with no staff can be deleted, and a rename leaves stations on the old value.

issues: The Taglia select sits between the Codice Fiscale input and its 'Non ho un Codice Fiscale italiano' checkbox, which splits the CF block. Move Taglia below the CF checkbox.

action_items: Decide and apply exclusion of archived persons (persons.archiviato) from /api/staff and the Ospitalità/hospitality lists (or show them as archived).
tipi_postazione: include planner project station features (properties.tipologia) in usage and rename.
Partecipa.jsx: move the Taglia field after the 'Non ho un Codice Fiscale italiano' checkbox.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/settings (update_settings) still accepts any body from an org admin and can overwrite list keys and 'disattivati' directly, bypassing the 409 checks in /settings/lists. Consider stripping LISTS keys there.
PersonMask CF lookup fills luogo_nascita but not data_nascita or age from the CF; the age stays blank until the date is entered by hand. This may be intended.

tests/test_option_lists_taglia.py cleanup left the TEST_OL_a_1794955550861 organization doc behind in one run (its users were removed). Cleanup should be made more robust, e.g. purge the org by id even if the per-collection deletes fail.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 executed passed, 7 skipped in existing suite)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Event Planner/Control Room inline add verified by code review only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login has a 'Prenota demo' popup ('Non ora') and a cookie banner ('Accept all') to dismiss. Event Planner and Control Room are locked on trial orgs. The mask save needs an event selected in each association row (Aggiungi Staff pre-adds one). The OptionListsManager delete uses window.confirm. Run pytest with -n 0 for a single file.
